candidate.educational_objective: Recognize living wills and health care proxies or durable powers of attorney for health care as forms of advance directives.
candidate.rationale: Medicare describes an advance directive as a legal document that records future medical-treatment wishes if a person becomes unable to make decisions. It identifies a health care proxy or durable power of attorney as the person designated to make health decisions and a living will as the document describing desired treatments.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Advance directives document future health care wishes and may include a health care proxy or durable power of attorney and a living will.
candidate.source_locator: Description > Advance directives include 2 parts: health care proxy/durable power of attorney and living will
candidate.source_organization: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) / Medicare
candidate.stem: A living will and a health care proxy or durable power of attorney for health care are examples of what type of document?
